summary: This note describes the cast and production approach of Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins. The live-action film casts Robbie Amell as Fred, Kate Melton as Daphne, Hayley Kiyoko as Velma and Nick Palatas as Shaggy. Scooby-Doo is rendered with computer-generated imagery and voiced by Frank Welker, who previously voiced Fred in the earlier animated series.
one_line: Cast and production notes for the live-action Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins, including its CGI Scooby-Doo and voice actor Frank Welker.

Nick Palatas plays Shaggy in Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins.
Scooby-Doo was created using computer-generated imagery in Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins.
Frank Welker provides the voice of Scooby-Doo in Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins.
Frank Welker was a cast member of the animated series Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!.
Frank Welker was a cast member of The Scooby-Doo Show.
Frank Welker provided the voice of Fred in Scooby-Doo, Where Are You! and The Scooby-Doo Show.
